Weekend seating plans rules
New handlers should know how a new handler works

This page matters because every animal in our care depends on calm, accurate handling, and travelers depend on us to prevent delay and distress. New staff must treat each booking as urgent, listen first, and confirm every comfort need before any carrier moves. The welfare coordinator reviews the animal's needs, while the ground team keeps movement smooth and careful. If a traveler arrives anxious, answer promptly and with respect, because uncertainty spreads quickly and pets sense it at once.

When checking acceptance, read the booking notes closely and follow the carrier rules without improvisation. <<FACT F064>> Never soften a limit or promise an exception, since the safest choice is always the one that fits the published standard. If the carrier is unsuitable, explain the problem plainly and guide the traveler to the next safe step. <<FACT F068>> Record only what is confirmed, and pass concerns to the welfare coordinator at once.

Remember that clear communication protects the animal, the traveler, and Aurelia Skyways, so act quickly, speak clearly, and never leave a doubt unaddressed.
